blocks.text: Pelajaran ini tentang apa yang bisa kamu lakukan: «aku bisa menghilangkan noda ini», «umur sepuluh, aku sudah lancar membaca», «boleh aku coba?», «kita akan bisa mencapainya». Hampir selalu, setelah kata utama ada kata kerja seperti di kamus, tanpa to.

examples.en: I can remove this stain.
At ten, I could read fluently.
examples.translation: Umur sepuluh, aku sudah lancar membaca.

examples.en: May I have a sample?
We will be able to achieve this goal.
examples.translation: Kita akan bisa mencapai tujuan ini.

blocks.text: can + kata kerja seperti di kamus: I can remove this stain. Can sama untuk semua: he can, she can, tanpa -s. Tidak bisa — cannot: We cannot talk in private. Setelah can tidak pernah ada to.

examples.en: I can remove this stain.
She can replace the battery.
We can arrange a meeting.
Noise can affect your sleep.
We cannot talk in private.
examples.translation: Kita tidak bisa bicara berdua saja.

fixes.wrong: I can to describe the place.

drill.why: Setelah can, kata kerja seperti di kamus: tanpa -s dan tanpa to.

blocks.text: Untuk bilang apa yang dulu sudah bisa kamu lakukan — could: At ten, I could read fluently — «umur sepuluh, aku sudah lancar membaca». Bahasa Indonesia cukup tambah «dulu», bahasa Inggris ganti can jadi could. Tanpa to juga.

examples.en: At ten, I could read fluently.
examples.translation: Umur sepuluh, aku sudah lancar membaca.

examples.en: At six, I could write the alphabet.
examples.translation: Umur enam, aku sudah bisa menulis alfabet.

examples.en: At twelve, we could travel independently.
examples.translation: Umur dua belas, kami sudah bisa bepergian sendiri.

examples.en: At twenty, I could learn a new skill.
examples.translation: Umur dua puluh, aku cepat belajar keterampilan baru.

fixes.wrong: At ten, I can read fluently.
fixes.right: At ten, I could read fluently.

fixes.wrong: At ten, I could to read fluently.
fixes.right: At ten, I could read fluently.

drill.question: Kamu ingat masa kecil: umur sepuluh sudah lancar membaca. Kamu bilang apa?
drill.optionA: At ten, I can read fluently.
drill.optionB: At ten, I could read fluently.

blocks.text: Minta izin dengan sopan — May I + kata kerja? May I have a sample? — «boleh aku coba sedikit?». May di depan, sebelum I; setelah I kata kerja tanpa to. Bukan I may…?, urutannya dibalik.

examples.en: May I have a sample?
May I make a comment?
May I change the channel?
May I disturb you for a moment?
May I check the exact price?

fixes.wrong: May I to have a sample?

blocks.text: Could I…? — permintaan sopan lainnya: Could I pay in advance? — «boleh aku bayar di muka?». Di sini could bukan soal masa lalu, tapi permintaan. Urutannya sama: Could dulu, lalu I dan kata kerja tanpa to.

examples.en: Could I discuss my diet?
Could I bring my sibling?
Could I pay in advance?
Could I start right away?
Could I have it in writing?
examples.translation: Boleh aku minta itu secara tertulis?

fixes.wrong: Could I to discuss my diet?

blocks.text: am / is able to + kata kerja — juga «bisa», tapi dengan am / is dan to: I am able to cope with the stress. «Akan bisa» — will be able to: We will be able to achieve this goal. Jangan will can.

formula.text: sekarang: am / is able to + kata kerja
nanti: will be able to + kata kerja

examples.en: I am able to cope with the stress.
She is able to recover at home.
I am able to concentrate here.
We will be able to achieve this goal.
examples.translation: Kita akan bisa mencapai tujuan ini.

examples.en: We will be able to pay this debt.
examples.translation: Kita akan bisa melunasi utang ini.

fixes.wrong: We will can achieve this goal.
fixes.right: We will be able to achieve this goal.

fixes.wrong: I able to cope with the stress.
fixes.right: I am able to cope with the stress.

fixes.wrong: I am able cope with the stress.
fixes.right: I am able to cope with the stress.

drill.why: «Akan bisa» — will be able to, will can tidak ada.

sections.title: Kesalahan yang dibuat hampir semua orang

fixes.wrong: I can to describe the place.
At ten, I can read fluently.
fixes.right: At ten, I could read fluently.

fixes.wrong: I am able cope with the stress.
fixes.right: I am able to cope with the stress.

fixes.wrong: We will can achieve this goal.
fixes.right: We will be able to achieve this goal.

blocks.text: Setelah can, could, May I, dan Could I — kata kerja seperti di kamus, tanpa to. Di able to justru perlu to, dan di depannya am / is atau will be.
Bisa — can. Dulu sudah bisa — could. Minta dengan sopan — May I…? atau Could I…?. Akan bisa — will be able to. Setelah can dan could tanpa to, setelah able pakai to.

examples.en: I can keep up with you.
May I offer an apology?
She is able to participate in the class.
